Comments:
-Layout (7/10): The main sections appear in the correct order, with centered offer cards and a full-width bundle banner. However, the generated hero is too tall, shifting the banner and following section downward; the TV category cards visible at the bottom of the reference are below the generated screenshot’s fold.
-Elements (10/15): Most key components are present, including the offer buttons, bundle banner, and section heading. The left offer shows HBO Max in place of the Disney+ branding shown in the reference, and the lower category cards are not visible.
-Content and Text (33/40): Most prominent headings, pricing, and bundle copy are close to the reference. Some branding and offer details differ, and less of the “All The TV You Love” section is shown.
-Style (7/15): The dark streaming-page look and bright green buttons are broadly consistent, but the reference has a clearly visible, colorful collage behind the hero. The generated background is so dark that most of the imagery is difficult to make out.
-Overall (13/20): The page captures the general structure and much of the copy, but the overly dark and taller hero changes the visual balance and pushes content out of view.

Score: 70/100

Comments:
- **Layout (2/10):** The reference shows the “All The TV You Love” section at the top, with four content cards, followed by a Live TV offer. The generated page instead starts with bundle promotions; the matching section only begins near the bottom.
- **Elements (3/15):** Both pages use a dark background and green accents, but the reference’s four show/movie cards and Live TV call-to-action are missing from the visible generated area. The generated page has bundle logos, offer panels, and buttons instead.
- **Content and Text (8/40):** The “All The TV You Love” heading and its description match, but most visible content differs. The reference includes category labels and a Live TV headline, description, and trial button; the generated page focuses on bundle pricing and offers.
- **Style (8/15):** The dark streaming-service aesthetic, white typography, and bright green buttons are broadly similar. However, the visible content, section hierarchy, and spacing differ substantially.
- **Overall (3/20):** There is some brand-style similarity and one matching section, but the pages show different portions of the site and do not align in their visible composition.

Score: **24/100**

Comments:
- **Layout (5/10):** Both pages use a wide, centered Hulu-style layout with dark full-width sections, but the visible structures differ substantially. The first shows a large hero/CTA followed by a sports feature section, while the second shows a bundle promotional banner and a four-card content grid.
- **Elements (6/15):** Some common elements are present, including green promotional labels, white headings, CTA buttons, and media imagery. However, the first screenshot includes sports branding, a background athlete image, and a video-preview panel that are absent from the second.
- **Content and Text (8/40):** The wording and messaging are largely different. The first focuses on “Watch Live TV From 95 Channels” and live sports, whereas the second focuses on the Disney+/Hulu/HBO Max bundle and “All The TV You Love.” Text hierarchy is similar, but actual content has low overlap.
- **Style (11/15):** Strong stylistic similarity: black/dark backgrounds, bright green accent color, bold white sans-serif typography, centered promotional messaging, and entertainment imagery. The second screenshot is cleaner and more card-grid oriented, while the first uses a dramatic green sports background.
- **Overall (7/20):** The pages appear to share Hulu branding and a general visual system, but the visible sections, imagery, messaging, and composition are notably different.

**Score: 37/100**

Comments:
- **Layout (2/10):** Both use a dark, full-width layout, but the visible sections are different. One shows a live-sports hero and plan selector; the other shows content-category cards and a centered Live TV promotion.
- **Elements (3/15):** There is little overlap in visible components. The sports preview, league logos, and pricing cards do not match the poster cards, free-trial button, and channel link.
- **Content and Text (4/40):** The wording is largely different. Both mention Hulu and live TV, but the headings, descriptions, offers, and pricing content do not correspond.
- **Style (7/15):** Both use a dark background, white sans-serif text, and green accents, giving them some shared brand feel. The imagery and section styling differ substantially.
- **Overall (5/20):** The screenshots appear to show different portions or versions of a Hulu page. Shared branding and color treatment provide limited similarity, but the visible content and composition do not align.

**Score: 21/100**

Comments:
-Layout (2/10): Both pages use a dark, full-width layout with centrally aligned content, but the structures are fundamentally different. The reference presents a Live TV promotional hero followed by a sports feature section, while the generated page is a plan comparison table.
-Elements (2/15): The reference includes a promotional headline, CTA button, channel-area link, tab navigation, sports logos, and imagery. The generated page instead contains plan cards, pricing rows, feature checkmarks, and a dropdown, with almost none of the reference elements reproduced.
-Content and Text (1/40): The text content is almost entirely unrelated. The reference focuses on “Watch Live TV From 95 Channels,” free trials, live sports, and channel offerings; the generated page focuses on Disney+/Hulu bundle pricing and subscription features.
-Style (5/15): There is limited stylistic overlap through the black background, white typography, centered presentation, and green accent color. However, the reference uses a more promotional, image-driven design with large hero spacing and CTA emphasis, while the generated page is a utilitarian comparison table.
-Overall (2/20): The generated webpage does not match the reference page’s purpose, section hierarchy, visual composition, or copy. Only the general dark theme and green accent provide minor similarity.

Score: 12/100

Comments:
- **Layout (10 points): 3/10** — Both pages use a dark Hulu-style layout with centered content, but the reference is positioned near the lower plan comparison and footer, while the generated page shows a large sports hero section and the beginning of the plan-selection area. The overall section structure and vertical composition differ substantially.
- **Elements (15 points): 6/15** — The generated page includes related plan cards, Hulu/Disney branding, and a plan-selection control, which partially correspond to the reference’s subscription content. However, the reference contains comparison rows, add-ons control, footer navigation, social icons, and legal links that are absent from the generated view.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 9/40** — The reference focuses on Disney+/Hulu bundle pricing, feature comparisons, savings, and footer links. The generated page instead emphasizes “Live Sports,” sports networks, promotional copy, and “Select Your Plan.” Only the general subscription context and some bundle names overlap.
- **Style (15 points): 10/15** — The dark background, white typography, centered Hulu subscription aesthetic, thin borders, and rounded white controls are broadly similar. The generated page adds a prominent green sports-themed hero background and imagery that are not present in the reference.
- **Overall (20 points): 7/20** — There is some brand and subscription-page resemblance, but the visible sections, hierarchy, content, and page state differ considerably. The generated page appears to be a related Hulu plan page rather than a close reproduction of the reference.

**Score: 35/100**
